o1: Enables protein kinase binding activity and protein phosphatase activator activity. Contributes to protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Predicted to enable protein phosphatase regulator activity. Involved in P granule assembly; determination of adult lifespan; negative regulation of insulin receptor signaling pathway; sarcomere organization; regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and cellular response to UV. Located in cytosol and the I band. Is expressed in excretory cell; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; reproductive system; and body-wall muscle. Interacts with UNC-89. Used to study cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including PPP2R5E (protein phosphatase 2 regulatory subunit B'epsilon).
